name: Toad

abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Instant Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Zehire immün, prowess kaldıran veya iyileşme engelleyen şampiyon kullan. İyileşme engeli olmadan da yenilebilir ama o zaman duvara sıkıştırma. Asla Skill şampiyon kullanma.
signatureAbility:
Paralytic Resins
When any Stun or personal Poison Debuff is Purified, Cleansed, or prevented by Immunity, gain an indefinite +[2-25]% Prowess Passive. Max stacks: 10.
When a personal Poison Debuff is prevented by Immunity, if Toad has 10 or more Prowess Passives, consume all personal Prowess Passives to inflict a Stun Passive for 3 seconds. This cannot be inflicted during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Toad is Immune to Poison and his Regeneration Rate cannot be reduced below 100%.

abilitySections.title: Paralytic Poison
content: When a Skill Opponent Purifies or Cleanses a Paralytic Poison Debuff, Toad has a 70% chance to inflict a [7,978.4] Paralytic Poison Passive for 30 seconds. This base potency scales with Toad's Special Damage.
When Toad is struck, he has a 7% chance to inflict a Paralytic Poison Debuff. Being struck with a Critical Hit has a 40% chance.
When the Opponent Dashes forward or Dodges back, they Purify one of Toad's Paralytic Poison Debuffs. Cooldown: 2 seconds.

When a Skill Opponent Purifies or Cleanses a Paralytic Poison Debuff, Toad has a 70% chance to inflict a [1,994.6] Paralytic Poison Passive for 8 seconds. This base potency scales with Toad's active Prowess potency.

abilitySections.title: At Max Paralytic Poison Debuffs
content: Convert all Paralytic Poison Debuffs into a [1,994.6] Paralytic Poison Passive fo 8 seconds. This base potency scales with Toad's Special Damage.
If the Opponent is not in a Special Attack, inflict a Stun Passive for 3 seconds. When it ends or if it would be inflicted during a Special Attack, it goes on cooldown for 10 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Each hit Purifies 1 Paralytic Poison Debuff on the Opponent to inflict an Instant Poison dealing a burst of [5,983.8] Direct Damage.

abilitySections.title: Paralytic Secretion - regeneration - Max: 3
content: If Toad is Struck while he is near a wall, Toad begins to secrete paralyzing toxins and gains a Regeneration Passive healing 5% of missing health over 8 seconds. These heal an additional 1% of missing Health for every hit in the Opponent's Combo Meter, up to 15.

When Toad is struck by a Critical Hit, or inflicted with a Bleed or Incinerate effect, he has a 20% chance to gain a personal Regeneration. Against Skill Champions, this gains +50% flat Ability Accuracy.
When Toad gains his Regeneration, he gains an indefinite 85% Prowess Passwive. Max Stacks: 4.
While his Regeneration is active, Toad's attacks have a 40% chance to inflict a Paralytic Poison Debuff on contact with the Opponent.
Toad's attacks pause his Regeneration for 0.50 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a Paralytic Secretion Regeneration Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation, inflict a Slow Passive for 30 seconds.
Each hit inflicts as Instant Poison dealing a burst of [4,986.5] Direct Damage. This base potency scales with Toad's Special Damage.
At the end of this attack, remove all personal Prowess Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a [9,973] Paralytic Poison Passive for 25 seconds. This base potency scales with Toad's Special Damage.
Removes all personal Prowess Passives.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Paralytic Resins
content: When any Stun or personal Poison Debuff is Purified, Cleansed, or prevented by Immunity, gain an indefinite +[2-25]% Prowess Passive. Max stacks: 10.

When a personal Poison Debuff is prevented by Immunity, if Toad has 10 or more Prowess Passives, consume all personal Prowess Passives to inflict a Stun Passive for 3 seconds. This cannot be inflicted during the Opponent's Special Attacks.
